s: Where's King Street, please?|请问国王街在哪里？
Go along this street and turn right.|沿着这条街走，然后右转。
Then you can see King Street on your left.|然后你就能看到国王街在你左边。
What did you do yesterday? I went to the shops.|你昨天做了什么？我去商店了。
What did he do last Sunday? He visited his aunt.|他上周日做了什么？他去看姑姑了。
What did they do in the morning? They cleaned the house.|他们早上做了什么？他们打扫了房子。
When did you buy those shoes?|你什么时候买的那双鞋？
I bought them last month in Paris.|我上个月在巴黎买的。
They're beautiful, but they're uncomfortable.|它们很漂亮，但穿着不舒服。
When did you write the letter? I wrote it yesterday.|你什么时候写的信？昨天写的。
When did you have breakfast? I had it at seven.|你什么时候吃早饭的？七点。
When did you finish your work? I finished it last night.|你什么时候完成工作的？昨晚。
I have a terrible toothache.|我牙疼得厉害。
When did it start? Two days ago.|什么时候开始的？两天前。
Please make an appointment with the dentist.|请和牙医预约一下。
When did you see the doctor? I saw him last week.|你什么时候看的医生？上周。
When did you take the medicine? I took it this morning.|你什么时候吃的药？今天早上。
When did you go to the dentist? I went yesterday.|你什么时候去看的牙医？昨天。
I must go to the shops. I need some things.|我必须去商店。我需要买些东西。
Here's my shopping list. Make a list too.|这是我的购物单。你也列一份吧。
I must buy some meat and vegetables.|我必须买些肉和蔬菜。
I must go to the butcher's. I need some meat.|我必须去肉店。我需要买点肉。
I must go to the grocer's. I need some sugar.|我必须去杂货店。我需要买糖。
I must go to the post office. I need some stamps.|我必须去邮局。我需要买邮票。
What did you have for lunch?|你午饭吃了什么？
I had roast beef and potatoes.|我吃了烤牛肉和土豆。
Did you have any vegetables? Yes, I had some peas.|你吃蔬菜了吗？吃了，我吃了些豌豆。
I had a cup of tea and a biscuit this morning.|今天早上我喝了一杯茶，吃了一块饼干。
I had a lovely holiday last summer.|去年夏天我度过了一个愉快的假期。
I had a good time at the party.|在聚会上我玩得很开心。
Where are you going for your holiday?|你打算去哪度假？
We're going to Paris, but we haven't had a holiday for years.|我们要去巴黎，不过我们好几年没度假了。
Have you had your holidays yet? Yes, we have.|你们休假了吗？休了。
Have you had your lunch yet? Yes, I have.|你吃过午饭了吗？吃过了。
Have you had your dinner? Not yet.|你吃过晚饭了吗？还没有。
Have you had a good holiday? Yes, we have.|你们假期过得好吗？很好。
Have you ever been to Paris? Yes, I have.|你去过巴黎吗？去过。
I went there in the spring. It was beautiful.|我春天去的。那里很美。
What have you done today? I've been very busy.|你今天做了什么？我一直很忙。
What have you done this morning?|你今天上午做了什么？
I've cleaned the house and washed the clothes.|我打扫了房子，洗了衣服。
What have you done? I've finished my homework.|你做了什么？我完成了作业。
There was a car crash near here yesterday.|昨天这附近发生了一起车祸。
Have you heard about it yet? Yes, I have.|你听说那件事了吗？听说了。
Was anyone hurt? No, they were lucky.|有人受伤吗？没有，他们很幸运。
Have you finished your homework yet? Not yet.|你作业做完了吗？还没有。
Have you seen that film yet? Yes, I have.|你看过那部电影了吗？看过了。
Have you written to him yet? No, I haven't.|你给他写信了吗？还没有。
That house is for sale. Have you seen it yet?|那栋房子在出售。你看过了吗？
Yes, I have. I saw it last week.|是的，看过了。我上周看的。
It's very nice, but it's too expensive.|房子很好，但太贵了。
Have you had your breakfast yet? Yes, I have.|你吃早饭了吗？吃了。
Have you read this book yet? No, not yet.|你读过这本书吗？还没有。
Have you met my brother yet? Yes, I have.|你见过我哥哥了吗？见过了。
Poor Ian! He's very unhappy.|可怜的伊恩！他很不开心。
When will he come back? He'll come back tomorrow.|他什么时候回来？明天。
When will you see him? I'll see him next week.|你什么时候见他？下周。
When will you go to Beijing? I'll go next month.|你什么时候去北京？下个月。
When will she arrive? She'll arrive at nine.|她什么时候到？九点。
When will they finish? They'll finish on Friday.|他们什么时候完成？周五。
Our new neighbour is a pilot. His name is Nigel.|我们的新邻居是飞行员。他叫奈杰尔。
When did you go to New York? I went there last year.|你什么时候去的纽约？去年。
When will you go to New York? I'll go next month.|你什么时候去纽约？下个月。

t: When did you/will you go to...?
s: When did you go to Spain? I went there in June.|你什么时候去的西班牙？六月。
When will you go to Spain? I'll go in July.|你什么时候去西班牙？七月。
When did they go to Japan? They went last year.|他们什么时候去的日本？去年。
Tickets, please.|请出示车票。
Here you are. What's the exact time, please?|给你。请问现在准确时间是几点？
It's half past four by my watch.|我的表是四点半。
What's the exact time? It's three minutes past six.|准确时间是几点？六点零三分。
My watch is slow. What's the exact time?|我的表慢了。准确时间是几点？
The train leaves at twenty-five past eight.|火车八点二十五分发车。

g: Whose is it? 与 have got
s: Whose is this small blue case?|这个蓝色小箱子是谁的？
Do you have any idea? It isn't mine.|你知道吗？不是我的。
Let's look inside. There's a name and address.|我们看看里面。有个名字和地址。

t: Whose is it? Do you have any...?
s: Whose is this umbrella? Is it yours?|这伞是谁的？是你的吗？
No, it isn't mine. I don't have any umbrella.|不，不是我的。我没有伞。
Do you have any matches? Yes, I have some.|你有火柴吗？有，我有一些。
Ow! That hurts! Be careful.|哎哟！好疼！小心点。
He says that he has a bad headache.|他说他头痛得厉害。
She says that she doesn't like coffee.|她说她不喜欢咖啡。
He says that he is very tired.|他说他很累。
She says that she will come tomorrow.|她说她明天会来。
They say that the film is very good.|他们说那部电影很好看。
I've got a card from Jimmy.|我收到吉米的一张明信片。
He says that he's having a wonderful time.|他说他玩得很开心。
He says that he'll be back next week.|他说他下周回来。
He says that he can't come today.|他说他今天来不了。
She says that she has finished her work.|她说她已完成工作。
They say that they want to help us.|他们说他们想帮我们。
How was the French test? It was very easy.|法语考试怎么样？很简单。
But the last question was too difficult.|但最后一题太难了。
I didn't have enough time to finish it.|我没有足够的时间做完。
This box is too heavy for me to carry.|这个箱子太重了，我搬不动。
This one is very light. It's easy to carry.|这个很轻。很容易搬。
Do you have enough money to buy it?|你有足够的钱买它吗？
I want you to type this letter again.|我要你把这封信重打一遍。
It's full of mistakes.|它全是错误。
Tell him to be more careful next time.|告诉他下次细心一点。

t: I want you to... Tell him to...
s: I want him to come at six o'clock.|我要他六点来。
Tell her to bring her book tomorrow.|告诉她明天把书带来。
Tell them to wait outside, please.|请让他们在外面等。
This hat is too small for me.|这顶帽子对我来说太小了。
How do they compare? This one is bigger.|它们相比怎么样？这个更大。
Is that one the biggest? No, this one is.|那个是最大的吗？不，这个是。
Which is taller, Tom or Tim? Tom is.|汤姆和蒂姆谁更高？汤姆。
Is this book more interesting than that one?|这本书比那本更有趣吗？
Yes, it's the most interesting book I have.|是的，它是我最有趣的一本书。
